title: Fix taskkill background_command in acp_mcp_bridge and Windows timeout in installer_contract
goal: acp_mcp_bridge.rs launched taskkill via Command::new violating tests/no_console_window.rs (unattended console launches must use background_command). installer_contract.rs hardcoded a 20s timeout in run_bash causing release_sync_check_uname_fallback_isolated_systemd_guard_and_qualified_sync to fail on Windows where multi-process MSYS2 runs take ~38s. Fix both to unblock Windows release qualification.
limitations: Test-only fixes for Windows console launch policy and bash execution timeout on development main.
